# Laravel v0.1.0 report artifacts

These twelve files are byte-for-byte copies of the six approved JSON and Markdown reports from the signed `v0.1.0` tag at commit `a8d154826f35fcb25a22868556534cc8c0331c0c`.

The SHA-256 values in `tests/fixtures/contracts/v0.1.json` lock these release artifacts independently from the mutable development snapshots under `packages/laravel/tests/Snapshots`. Do not regenerate this directory during ordinary snapshot updates. Any correction requires explicit compatibility review and documented provenance.
